question.text: An Investor Charter of a Cat III AIF must describe:

answer.text: Services, grievance redressal, timelines, investor responsibilities

explanation.text: The Logic: An Investor Charter contains the services provided to investors, the grievance redressal mechanism, service timelines and investor responsibilities (pp. 140-141). The Trap: Narrow versions covering only fees, only performance or only AUM do not meet the Investor Charter requirement. Note: New schemes disclose the Investor Charter in the PPM; existing schemes disclose it to investors by registered e-mail (pp. 140-141).
